meta.goal: Map the Main Block, plan rooftop solar with an environmental review, check solar health, faults and bills, verify export credit with partner campuses, then optimise and control tomorrow.

nodes.label: Supervisor
nodes.role: Plans the route from the goal and mode, then hands over to one agent at a time.

nodes.label: Mapping Agent
nodes.role: Builds the building model from blueprints, Google Solar API, Open Buildings, OSM, RoomPlan, CCTV and meters (HUKUM Scan).

nodes.label: Solar Planner
nodes.role: Sizes and lays out rooftop solar + battery, yield and payback.

nodes.label: Environmental Engineer
nodes.role: Reviews every solar plan in a loop: setbacks, shading, structure, CO2, water, glare. Sends it back until it passes.

nodes.label: Solar Health Agent
nodes.role: Performance ratio, string-level faults, soiling and inverter health.

nodes.label: Fault & Maintenance Agent
nodes.role: Turns anomalies into prioritised work orders and predicts failures.

nodes.label: Bill Auditor
nodes.role: Checks utility bills against meter data and the tariff; finds overcharges.

nodes.label: Multi-Campus Negotiator
nodes.role: Verifies export credit and trades surplus solar between campuses at a fair price.

nodes.label: Control Agent
nodes.role: Turns plans into safe actions on rooms, HVAC, pumps, EVs and battery; respects the pilot mode.

nodes.label: State Optimiser
nodes.role: Solves the next 24 h (96 slots) for minimum cost within comfort and safety limits.

nodes.label: Reporter
nodes.role: Writes the final briefing with KPIs.

review.title: Nameplate says 15 kW, the meter sees 8.25 kW
review.detail: PUMP-1 and PUMP-2 have identical 15 kW nameplates. NILM on the Main Block meter found a 8.25 kW load (55% of rated) running 2 times, at 06:02, 18:41.
